prompt: what is the best cad software for linux for aircraft and mechanical design?
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Recommend CAD software options usable on Linux for aircraft/mechanical design; (2) provide brief justification and/or factors. Candidate [4] best follows this and avoids major overclaims by noting non-native Linux support (e.g., SolidWorks via Wine) and keeping tools mostly CAD-appropriate (2D drafting tools separated from 3D CAD/simulation). Candidates [2] and [3] contain multiple likely factual errors about commercial aerospace/mechanical CAD being directly available for Linux (e.g., claims about Fusion 360/CATIA/SolidWorks/FalconView availability), which severely hurts correctness, while Candidate [1] is relatively plausible but includes at least one non-CAD tool (GIMP/GIMPSTUDIO) and is less focused on aircraft-relevant CAD capability.
